cash_reservation_terminal.name: cash_reservation_terminal
cash_reservation_terminal.value: ("cash_reservations"."status" = 'held' AND "cash_reservations"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("cash_reservations"."status" <> 'held' AND "cash_reservations"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_reservations"."resolved_at" >= "cash_reservations"."created_at")

exit_proceeds.name: exit_proceeds
exit_proceeds.value: ("exit_allocations"."status" = 'consumed' AND "exit_allocations"."proceeds_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "exit_allocations"."proceeds_cents" >= 0 AND "exit_allocations"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "exit_allocations"."resolved_at" >= "exit_allocations"."created_at") OR ("exit_allocations"."status" = 'released' AND "exit_allocations"."proceeds_cents" IS NULL AND "exit_allocations"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "exit_allocations"."resolved_at" >= "exit_allocations"."created_at") OR ("exit_allocations"."status" = 'held' AND "exit_allocations"."proceeds_cents" IS NULL AND "exit_allocations"."resolved_at" IS NULL)

ledger_shape.name: ledger_shape
ledger_shape.value: ("ledger_events"."kind" = 'starting_grant' AND "ledger_events"."order_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_events"."artist_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_events"."available_delta" = 100000 AND "ledger_events"."reserved_delta" = 0) OR ("ledger_events"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_events"."artist_id" IS NOT NULL AND (("ledger_events"."kind" = 'buy_reserve' AND "ledger_events"."available_delta" < 0 AND "ledger_events"."available_delta"::numeric + "ledger_events"."reserved_delta"::numeric = 0) OR ("ledger_events"."kind" = 'buy_cancel' AND "ledger_events"."available_delta" > 0 AND "ledger_events"."available_delta"::numeric + "ledger_events"."reserved_delta"::numeric = 0) OR ("ledger_events"."kind" = 'buy_settle' AND "ledger_events"."available_delta" = 0 AND "ledger_events"."reserved_delta" < 0) OR ("ledger_events"."kind" = 'sell_settle' AND "ledger_events"."available_delta" >= 0 AND "ledger_events"."reserved_delta" = 0)))

accepted_snapshot_complete.name: accepted_snapshot_complete
accepted_snapshot_complete.value: ("listener_snapshots"."status" = 'accepted' AND "listener_snapshots"."listener_count" IS NOT NULL AND "listener_snapshots"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "listener_snapshots"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("listener_snapshots"."status" = 'quarantined' AND "listener_snapshots"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

order_intent.name: order_intent
order_intent.value: ("orders"."side" = 'buy' AND "orders"."amount_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."amount_cents" >= 100 AND "orders"."exit_basis_points" IS NULL) OR ("orders"."side" = 'sell' AND "orders"."amount_cents" IS NULL AND "orders"."exit_basis_points" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."exit_basis_points" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)

order_terminal_time.name: order_terminal_time
order_terminal_time.value: ("orders"."status" = 'queued' AND "orders"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "orders"."settled_at" IS NULL) OR ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "orders"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."cancelled_at" >= "orders"."accepted_at" AND "orders"."settled_at" IS NULL) OR ("orders"."status" = 'settled' AND "orders"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."settled_at" >= "orders"."accepted_at" AND "orders"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

lot_quanta.name: lot_quanta
lot_quanta.value: "position_lots"."initial_quanta" = 1000000000000 AND "position_lots"."remaining_quanta" BETWEEN 0 AND "position_lots"."initial_quanta" AND "position_lots"."reserved_quanta" BETWEEN 0 AND "position_lots"."remaining_quanta"

batch_terminal.name: batch_terminal
batch_terminal.value: ("settlement_batches"."status" = 'sealed' AND "settlement_batches"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "settlement_batches"."skip_reason" IS NULL) OR ("settlement_batches"."status" = 'executed' AND "settlement_batches"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL AND "settlement_batches"."executed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "settlement_batches"."executed_at" >= "settlement_batches"."sealed_at" AND "settlement_batches"."executed_at" < "settlement_batches"."cutoff" + interval '2 hours' AND "settlement_batches"."skip_reason" IS NULL) OR ("settlement_batches"."status" = 'skipped' AND "settlement_batches"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "settlement_batches"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL)

reviewed_soundcloud_fallback.name: reviewed_soundcloud_fallback
reviewed_soundcloud_fallback.value: "tracks"."soundcloud_url" IS NULL OR ("tracks"."spotify_track_id" IS NULL AND "tracks"."spotify_absence_reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)
